title: Python Array Operations and List Methods
learningObjectives: Explain the purpose and core concepts of Python Array Operations and List Methods.
Select suitable Python structures or library operations for the task.
Trace the effect of each operation on the data or figure.
Validate results and interpret output accurately.
Identify limitations, edge cases and maintainability considerations.

understand.concept: List methods provide common array-like operations: append and insert add values, extend adds values from an iterable, pop and remove delete values, index and count inspect values, and sort or reverse change order. Methods such as pop return a removed item, while most mutating list methods return None.
understand.whyItMatters: Selecting the correct operation avoids accidental nested lists, lost return values and unexpected mutation.
understand.analogy: Choose the data structure or chart that matches the information being represented; visual similarity does not mean two structures have identical behavior.
understand.summary: Python Array Operations and List Methods adds a focused capability to the Python curriculum.

explain.narrative: Read the concept, run each example in order, inspect the returned values and figure objects, and compare the result with the stated expectation. The examples use deterministic data and a non-interactive Matplotlib backend so they can be validated in automation.

examples.title: Append one element
examples.explanation: append adds its argument as one new element.

examples.title: Extend with multiple values
examples.explanation: extend iterates over the supplied iterable and adds each item.

examples.title: Insert at an index
examples.explanation: insert places an item before the specified index.

examples.title: Remove and capture an item
examples.explanation: pop removes and returns the item at the selected index.

examples.title: Count and find values
examples.explanation: count reports occurrences; index returns the first matching position.

questions.prompt: What is the difference between append and extend?
questions.answer: append adds one object; extend adds items from an iterable
options: append adds one object; extend adds items from an iterable
questions.explanation: append treats its argument as one item; extend iterates through it.
pop removes and returns the selected element.

questions.prompt: Which method inserts before an index?
questions.explanation: insert(index, value) places the value at the chosen position.
sort mutates the list in place and returns None.

questions.prompt: What happens when remove(value) finds repeated values?
questions.answer: It removes the first matching occurrence
options: It removes the first matching occurrence
questions.explanation: remove deletes only the first matching item.
